name: Orgnil Soulscar
summary: At Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar watches for danger among the orcs of Durotar. He gathers reports and helps direct defenses, with the Burning Blade cult in the canyons foremost in his thoughts.

sections.title: Watcher of Razor Hill
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar watches for hidden threats across Durotar from Razor Hill. Grunt patrols guard against Alliance forces and centaur raiders, while he searches for danger among the orcs themselves. Scouts bring reports from across the region. Orgnil studies them for signs of corrupt rites and secret gatherings.

sections.title: Hunting the Shadow Council's Remnants
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar hunts the Burning Blade cult, whose warlocks hide in caves such as Skull Rock. Fel magic devastated the orcish people in past generations, and Orgnil will not let demon worship gain ground near Orgrimmar. He sends trusted recruits to confront cultists and gather ritual talismans. He also sends them to seek counsel from local hermits and shamans such as Margoz about the dark magic at work.

faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar directs defense from Razor Hill, investigating threats and guiding warriors and scouts against dangers to the newly settled orc lands.

faq.q: What threat is Orgnil most worried about?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar is intent on rooting out the Burning Blade cult. Its hidden presence in Durotar's caverns and its corrupting fel magic threaten the fresh start Thrall envisions for the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil send travelers to Margoz?
faq.answer: Margoz is a knowledgeable hermit living north of Razor Hill who understands the Burning Blade's signs and rituals. Orgnil sends scouts to him to read the cult's movements and investigate the spreading magical corruption.

faq.q: Where can Orgnil Soulscar be found?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar is stationed outdoors in Razor Hill, near Durotar's central crossroads.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade in Durotar?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is a cult bound to demonic masters and the Shadow Council. Its members hide in ravines such as Skull Rock and Dustwind Cave, seeking to poison Durotar's wildlife and draw young orcs back into demonic service.

faq.q: Does Orgnil work directly for Thrall?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar serves in the regional defense force based in Razor Hill, carrying out the Warchief's order to protect Durotar from sedition and demonic influence.

angles.text: As a young orc, you can look to Orgnil as a guard against the demonic taint that once enslaved the clans. His work reminds new recruits to stay alert and keep their homeland pure.
As a warlock, tread carefully around Orgnil. He hunts uncontrolled demonic corruption within Durotar.
As a member of the Horde, you can count on Orgnil to guard its heartland from cultists while the Horde builds its new nation.
